en.headline: HKTDC takes Hong Kong Shopping Festival to Singapore and Malaysia
en.dek: After the mainland edition drew 115 million views, the first ASEAN edition runs from 21 to 27 September on Shopee and Lazada with about 100 Hong Kong brands.
body: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council said the third Hong Kong Shopping Festival on the mainland recorded more than 115 million page views and will now open an ASEAN edition from 21 to 27 September, its first expansion beyond the mainland market.

The ASEAN programme will list about 100 Hong Kong brands and more than 300 products on dedicated pages of Shopee and Lazada in Singapore and Malaysia. The council said firms that do not yet sell on those platforms can use a limited-time online store to test demand.

Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau said the first ASEAN edition would help local firms tap a larger e-commerce market and raise the profile of Hong Kong products. An HKTDC deputy executive director said the mainland edition had shown that Hong Kong brands remain a mark of quality and that the council would use that experience as it expands later to other ASEAN markets.

zh.headline: 香港好物節首次登陸星馬電商 9月21日起舉行
zh.dek: 內地站總瀏覽人次逾1.15億後，貿發局將於9月21至27日在新加坡及馬來西亞Shopee、Lazada推出東盟站，約100個港商品牌參與。
body: 香港貿易發展局表示，第三屆「香港好物節（中國內地）」全網總瀏覽人次突破1.15億，活動將於9月21至27日首次延伸至東盟，登陸新加坡及馬來西亞電商平台。
東盟站預料匯聚約100個香港品牌、逾300款產品，並在Shopee及Lazada開設活動專頁。貿發局稱，尚未進駐當地平台的港商可使用期間限定網上店上架，測試市場反應。
商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺表示，好物節首次伸延至東盟，有助本地企業開拓更大電商市場，提升港產品牌知名度。貿發局副總裁指內地站反映香港品牌仍是質素保證，並會憑相關經驗逐步推廣至其他主要東盟國家。
